This is in agreement with the results of Peredo & Tataronis (1990), the shifts of the frequency modify the location of the resonant surfaces in such a way that one of the natural modes is closer to the resonance while the other is further away from the resonance relative to the static situation. As a consequence, one mode is damped more efficiently than the other. Nevertheless, the effect of the flow does not significantly change the damping per period for the regime considered here (0 < u;/ < 0.1).
